description: This file defines an immutable singleton class `ImmutableJsonObjectNull`, which represents a null JSON object, implementing `JsonObject` and `JsonNull` interfaces. It provides methods to access and manipulate JSON object values, all of which are effectively no-ops or return placeholders, as this class signifies a null or empty JSON object.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonObjectNull
classes.description: An immutable singleton class representing a null JSON object, providing various no-op and accessor methods consistent with a null object pattern.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of `ImmutableJsonObjectNull`, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Indicates that this JSON value is null, returning true.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Indicates that this JSON value is an object, returning true.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns this object as an `ImmutableJsonObjectNull`.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: All setValue methods return the singleton instance without modifying state, as this class represents a null object.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets values or fields, but since this is a null object, methods simply return the singleton instance.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Attempts to set multiple fields, but this implementation is a no-op.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks for a key, always returns false for this null object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a nested object or field at a given pointer or selector, always returns the singleton null object.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a value for a key or field definition, returning empty or throwing if not present.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key, a no-op here. Always returns the singleton instance.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns an empty list, as this object contains no keys.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a field by key, returning empty.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an empty iterator.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the object is empty.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0, as the object has no fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Equality check, true if the object is a `JsonNull`.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Hash code based on `JsonNull` class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of JSON null literal.
